garments.name: Senator Outfit
garments.description: Traditional Nigerian outfit commonly consisting of a top and trousers.

garments.name: Kaftan
garments.description: A broad category for loose or tailored tunic-and-trouser native outfits and robe-like garments. In Nigerian usage, some Senator styles are treated as kaftan/native-wear variants.

garments.name: Corporate Shirt
garments.description: A structured shirt designed for formal or professional wear.

garments.name: Bubu Gown
garments.description: A loose-fitting gown with a flowing silhouette.

garments.name: A-line Dress
garments.description: A dress that gradually widens from the upper body toward the hem.

garments.name: Fitted Gown
garments.description: A gown designed to follow the body's contours.

garments.name: Pleated Skirt
garments.description: A skirt featuring folds arranged along the fabric.

garments.name: Blouse
garments.description: An upper-body garment that can be styled for casual or formal occasions.

garments.name: Trousers
garments.description: Lower-body garments with separate legs. Styles can be distinguished by leg shape, fit, rise, waist treatment, and construction.

garments.name: T-Shirt
garments.description: A casual knitted shirt with short sleeves.

garments.name: Jacket
garments.description: An outer garment for layering, available in casual and structured designs.

garments.name: Shirts
garments.description: Upper-body garments commonly constructed with a body, neckline or collar, sleeves, and optional front opening.

garments.name: Agbada
garments.description: A traditional West African outfit family featuring a flowing outer robe, usually worn over inner garments and trousers.

garments.name: Gowns
garments.description: One-piece garments, often long, with styles defined by silhouette, waist placement, volume, and construction.

garments.name: Skirts
garments.description: Lower-body garments hanging from the waist or hips; silhouette, fullness, panels, and length distinguish styles.

garments.name: Blouses
garments.description: Upper-body garments that may use varied front openings, necklines, sleeve shapes, waist shaping, and closures.

styles.name: Classic Senator
styles.description: A clean, straight-cut Senator outfit suited to formal traditional wear.

styles.name: Minimalist Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with limited decoration and a clean, simple design.

styles.name: Classic Corporate Shirt
styles.description: A structured button-up shirt designed for professional wear.

styles.name: Flowing Bubu Gown
styles.description: A relaxed traditional gown with a generous flowing silhouette.

styles.name: Classic A-line Dress
styles.description: A versatile dress that widens gradually from the bodice to the hem.

styles.name: Elegant Fitted Gown
styles.description: A contour-following gown for occasions, tailored to the wearer.

styles.name: Pleated Midi Skirt
styles.description: A mid-length skirt with regular pleats and a defined waist.

styles.name: Button-Front Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a front opening fastened by a row of buttons.

styles.name: Classic Button-Front Shirt
styles.description: A conventional shirt with a full-length front opening fastened with buttons.

styles.name: Dress Shirt
styles.description: A formal shirt typically made with a collar, button front, and cuffs for office or occasion wear.

styles.name: Oxford Shirt
styles.description: A shirt made in an Oxford-style cloth, often with a button-down collar.

styles.name: Button-Down Shirt
styles.description: A shirt whose collar points fasten to the shirt front with small buttons.

styles.name: Band-Collar Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with a short standing band collar instead of folded collar points.

styles.name: Grandad-Collar Shirt
styles.description: A casual shirt with a short band collar and usually a button-front opening.

styles.name: Camp-Collar Shirt
styles.description: A relaxed shirt with a soft, open collar that lies flat against the upper chest.

styles.name: Cuban-Collar Shirt
styles.description: A casual open-collar shirt, commonly with a straight hem and relaxed fit.

styles.name: Mandarin-Collar Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with a short upright collar and no folded collar points.

styles.name: Henley Shirt
styles.description: A collarless shirt with a short front placket, usually with a few buttons.

styles.name: Overshirt
styles.description: A heavier shirt designed to be worn as a light outer layer over another top.

styles.name: Utility Shirt
styles.description: A practical shirt featuring details such as patch pockets, tabs, or reinforced panels.

styles.name: Western Shirt
styles.description: A shirt influenced by Western wear, often featuring pointed yokes, snaps, or shaped pockets.

styles.name: Tunic Shirt
styles.description: A longer shirt extending below the hip, sometimes with side slits.

styles.name: Pleated-Front Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with decorative or structural pleats arranged on the front panel.

styles.name: Raglan-Sleeve Shirt
styles.description: A shirt whose sleeves extend to the neckline with diagonal seams from underarm to neck.

styles.name: Short-Sleeve Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with sleeves ending above the elbow; collar and front details may vary.

styles.name: Long-Sleeve Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with sleeves extending to the wrist, often finished with cuffs.

styles.name: Peplum Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with a fitted or shaped upper body and a flared section attached around the waist.

styles.name: Asymmetric Shirt
styles.description: A shirt with an intentionally uneven hem, closure, or panel arrangement.

styles.name: Straight-Leg Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a leg line that remains relatively consistent from thigh to hem.

styles.name: Slim-Fit Trousers
styles.description: Trousers cut close to the body without the very tight fit of skinny trousers.

styles.name: Skinny Trousers
styles.description: Close-fitting trousers with a narrow leg from thigh toward ankle.

styles.name: Tapered Trousers
styles.description: Trousers that gradually narrow toward the ankle.

styles.name: Wide-Leg Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with generous width through the legs, creating a broad hem opening.

styles.name: Flared Trousers
styles.description: Trousers that widen from the knee or lower leg toward the hem.

styles.name: Bootcut Trousers
styles.description: Trousers that are relatively fitted through the thigh and widen slightly at the hem.

styles.name: Palazzo Trousers
styles.description: Very wide-legged trousers, usually loose and flowing from the waist.

styles.name: Culotte Trousers
styles.description: Wide, cropped trousers that can resemble a skirt when standing.

styles.name: Barrel-Leg Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a curved leg shape that bulges around the knee and narrows toward the hem.

styles.name: Carrot-Fit Trousers
styles.description: Trousers fuller around the hips and thighs and tapered toward the ankle.

styles.name: Pleated-Front Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with one or more folds at the front waist to provide shaping or extra room.

styles.name: Flat-Front Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a smooth front waist and no front pleats.

styles.name: High-Waisted Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with the waistband positioned at or above the natural waist.

styles.name: Mid-Rise Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with the waistband positioned around the midsection between high and low rise.

styles.name: Low-Rise Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a waistband positioned below the natural waist.

styles.name: Cropped Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with hems ending above the ankle; leg shape can vary.

styles.name: Ankle-Length Trousers
styles.description: Trousers designed to finish around the ankle.

styles.name: Full-Length Trousers
styles.description: Trousers designed to extend to the shoe or lower ankle area.

styles.name: Cargo Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with utility-style pockets, often including large pockets on the thighs.

styles.name: Drawstring Trousers
styles.description: Trousers adjusted at the waist with a drawstring, often in a relaxed construction.

styles.name: Elastic-Waist Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with an elasticated waistband for flexible fit.

styles.name: Paperbag-Waist Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a gathered, raised waist often secured by a belt or tie.

styles.name: Pegged Trousers
styles.description: Trousers shaped fuller at the hip and tapered toward the lower leg.

styles.name: Harem Trousers
styles.description: Loose trousers with generous volume through the seat and crotch, tapering toward the ankle.

styles.name: Jeans-Style Trousers
styles.description: Trousers using denim-style construction details such as rivets, topstitching, and patch pockets.

styles.name: Formal Tailored Trousers
styles.description: Structured trousers with a clean waistband, tailored seams, and a formal finish.

styles.name: Women's Flowing Trousers
styles.description: Women's trousers designed with a generous, fluid leg, commonly using lightweight fabric.

styles.name: Women's Wide-Base Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a particularly broad hem opening; this is a descriptive label that may overlap with wide-leg or palazzo styles.

styles.name: Classic Agbada
styles.description: A traditional flowing outer robe with broad sleeves and generous volume, worn over an inner outfit.

styles.name: Embroidered Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada featuring decorative embroidery, often around the neckline, chest, front panels, or sleeves.

styles.name: Minimalist Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada with restrained decoration and emphasis on clean lines and fabric.

styles.name: Short Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada variation with a shorter outer robe than more traditional full-length forms.

styles.name: Long Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada with a long outer robe extending well below the knee, depending on the cut.

styles.name: Wide-Sleeve Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada emphasizing broad, voluminous sleeves.

styles.name: Layered Agbada Ensemble
styles.description: A coordinated look featuring the outer robe, inner tunic or top, and trousers.

styles.name: Formal Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada styled for formal events, often with refined fabric and finishing.

styles.name: Ceremonial Agbada
styles.description: An elaborate Agbada intended for ceremonies or important occasions, often with substantial ornamentation.

styles.name: Modern Tailored Agbada
styles.description: A contemporary interpretation with more controlled proportions or modern finishing.

styles.name: Contrast-Embroidery Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada using embroidery in a contrasting colour to highlight selected areas.

styles.name: Panelled Agbada
styles.description: An Agbada whose outer robe uses visible panel divisions as a design feature.

styles.name: Classic Kaftan
styles.description: A loose or semi-tailored tunic-style garment with a simple neckline and relaxed body.

styles.name: Senator Kaftan
styles.description: A contemporary Nigerian native outfit commonly pairing a tailored top with matching trousers.

styles.name: Mandarin-Collar Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan or native top with a short upright collar.

styles.name: Round-Neck Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with a round neckline, often used in contemporary native-wear designs.

styles.name: V-Neck Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with a V-shaped neckline opening.

styles.name: Embroidered Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with decorative embroidery around the neckline, placket, chest, cuffs, or hem.

styles.name: Short Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan top or tunic cut to a shorter length, commonly paired with trousers.

styles.name: Long Kaftan
styles.description: A longer kaftan garment extending toward the knee or below, depending on regional style.

styles.name: Zip-Front Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with a zipper used as the main or partial front opening.

styles.name: Button-Placket Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with a front placket fastened with buttons or decorative closures.

styles.name: Contrast-Panel Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan using contrasting fabric panels or colours as a design feature.

styles.name: Two-Tone Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan combining two main colours in its body, panels, or trim.

styles.name: Short-Sleeve Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with sleeves ending above the elbow.

styles.name: Long-Sleeve Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with sleeves extending to the wrist.

styles.name: Kaftan with Matching Trousers
styles.description: A coordinated native outfit pairing a kaftan-style top with trousers.

styles.name: Kaftan with Chest Pocket
styles.description: A kaftan or native top featuring one or more chest pockets.

styles.name: Kaftan with Side Slits
styles.description: A kaftan with side openings at the hem to improve movement or create a design detail.

styles.name: Asymmetric-Placket Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan with an off-centre or diagonal front placket.

styles.name: Belted Kaftan
styles.description: A kaftan shaped or accessorised with a belt or fabric tie.

styles.name: Open Kaftan
styles.description: An open-front kaftan-style outer layer worn over another garment.

styles.name: Kaftan Gown
styles.description: A long kaftan-inspired gown with a loose, straight, or flowing silhouette.

styles.name: Bubu Gown
styles.description: A loose, flowing gown with generous ease and a simple body shape; sleeve and neckline treatments vary.

styles.name: Flare Gown
styles.description: A gown that widens toward the hem, either gradually or from a defined waist or hip point.

styles.name: A-Line Gown
styles.description: A gown fitted or shaped at the upper body and gradually widening toward the hem.

styles.name: Fitted Gown
styles.description: A gown cut to follow the body's contours, with fit and ease determined by its pattern.

styles.name: Mermaid Gown
styles.description: A gown fitted through the bodice and hips, flaring more dramatically around the knee or lower leg.

styles.name: Trumpet Gown
styles.description: A fitted gown that begins flaring around the mid-thigh area, generally earlier than a mermaid silhouette.

styles.name: Straight Gown
styles.description: A gown with a relatively straight silhouette and limited flare.

styles.name: Column Gown
styles.description: A long, narrow gown that falls in a mostly vertical line.

styles.name: Flare-and-Fitted Gown
styles.description: A gown with a fitted upper section and a skirt that flares below the waist or hip.

styles.name: Empire-Waist Gown
styles.description: A gown with a waist seam or visual waistline raised to just below the bust.

styles.name: Fit-and-Flare Gown
styles.description: A gown with a shaped bodice and a skirt that flares from the waist or upper hip.

styles.name: Ball Gown
styles.description: A formal gown with a fitted or shaped bodice and a very full skirt.

styles.name: Evening Gown
styles.description: A long formal gown intended for evening or ceremonial occasions; its silhouette may vary.

styles.name: Off-Shoulder Gown
styles.description: A gown with a neckline that sits below the shoulders.

styles.name: One-Shoulder Gown
styles.description: A gown with an asymmetrical neckline supported by one shoulder.

styles.name: Halter-Neck Gown
styles.description: A gown with straps or fabric that wrap or fasten around the neck, leaving the shoulders exposed.

styles.name: Wrap Gown
styles.description: A gown with overlapping front panels secured by a tie, belt, or fastening.

styles.name: Shirt Gown
styles.description: A gown borrowing shirt details such as a collar, front placket, cuffs, or button opening.

styles.name: Pleated Gown
styles.description: A gown using pleats in the bodice, skirt, or both as a construction or decorative feature.

styles.name: Tiered Gown
styles.description: A gown made with horizontal sections or tiers that add volume or visual rhythm.

styles.name: High-Low Gown
styles.description: A gown with a hem that is shorter at the front and longer at the back.

styles.name: Smock Gown
styles.description: A loose gown with gathered or smocked sections, often designed for comfort and ease.

styles.name: Babydoll Gown
styles.description: A short or long loose dress with a raised waist and a fuller body below it.

styles.name: Drop-Waist Gown
styles.description: A gown whose waist seam or visual waistline sits below the natural waist.

styles.name: Cape Gown
styles.description: A gown incorporating a cape or cape-like overlay as part of its design.

styles.name: Corset-Bodice Gown
styles.description: A gown with a structured bodice inspired by corset construction.

styles.name: Lace Gown
styles.description: A gown in which lace is a major material or decorative component; silhouette may vary.

styles.name: Aso-Ebi Gown
styles.description: A gown made or styled for coordinated celebratory group attire; the specific cut can vary widely.

styles.name: Bridal Gown
styles.description: A gown designed for a wedding; silhouette, fabric, and embellishment vary.

styles.name: Prom Gown
styles.description: A formal event gown commonly designed with decorative or statement styling.

styles.name: Bishop-Sleeve Gown
styles.description: A gown featuring full sleeves gathered into a cuff at the wrist.

styles.name: Puff-Sleeve Gown
styles.description: A gown with sleeves gathered to create rounded volume at the shoulder or along the sleeve.

styles.name: Peplum-Waist Gown
styles.description: A gown with a short flared panel attached around the waist or hip.

styles.name: Asymmetric Gown
styles.description: A gown with an intentionally uneven neckline, hem, panel, or other design line.

styles.name: A-Line Skirt
styles.description: A skirt that fits at the waist or hip and gradually widens toward the hem.

styles.name: Pencil Skirt
styles.description: A narrow skirt that follows the hips and thighs, often with a vent or slit for movement.

styles.name: Straight Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with relatively even width from hip toward hem.

styles.name: Circle Skirt
styles.description: A full skirt shaped from a circle or near-circle of fabric.

styles.name: Half-Circle Skirt
styles.description: A flared skirt cut from approximately half a circle, usually less full than a full circle skirt.

styles.name: Pleated Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with repeated folds arranged as pleats.

styles.name: Knife-Pleat Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with narrow pleats folded consistently in one direction.

styles.name: Box-Pleat Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with pleats that meet in alternating directions to create box-like folds.

styles.name: Accordion-Pleat Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with many narrow, evenly spaced pleats that open and close like an accordion.

styles.name: Inverted-Pleat Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with pleat folds turned inward so the outer surface appears relatively flat.

styles.name: Wrap Skirt
styles.description: A skirt formed by overlapping fabric panels and securing them with ties, buttons, or another fastening.

styles.name: Gathered Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with fabric gathered into the waistband to create fullness.

styles.name: Tiered Skirt
styles.description: A skirt built from horizontal fabric tiers, often increasing fullness toward the hem.

styles.name: Gored Skirt
styles.description: A skirt constructed from shaped vertical panels called gores.

styles.name: Mermaid Skirt
styles.description: A skirt fitted through the hips and thighs that flares strongly near the lower leg.

styles.name: Trumpet Skirt
styles.description: A fitted skirt that begins to flare around the mid-thigh or knee area.

styles.name: Tulip Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with overlapping or curved panels that create a tulip-like outline.

styles.name: Asymmetric Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with an intentionally uneven hem or panel arrangement.

styles.name: Godet Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with triangular inserts that add flare toward the hem.

styles.name: Slip Skirt
styles.description: A simple skirt inspired by slip construction, often cut from lightweight fabric.

styles.name: Kilt-Style Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with wrap construction and overlapping panels, inspired by kilt design.

styles.name: Bubble Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with a hem turned or gathered inward to create a rounded, puffed outline.

styles.name: Peplum Skirt
styles.description: A skirt featuring a short flared overlay or peplum around the waist or hip.

styles.name: Culotte Skirt
styles.description: A divided garment with wide legs designed to resemble a skirt.

styles.name: High-Low Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with a hem that is shorter at the front and longer at the back.

styles.name: Maxi Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with a long hem typically reaching the ankle or near the floor.

styles.name: Midi Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with a hem falling around the mid-calf area.

styles.name: Mini Skirt
styles.description: A skirt with a hem well above the knee.

styles.name: Panelled Skirt
styles.description: A skirt assembled from multiple panels that shape its fit or create design lines.

styles.name: Flared Skirt
styles.description: A skirt that gradually widens from the waist or hip toward the hem.

styles.name: Side-Zip Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a zipper placed along a side seam for dressing and fit.

styles.name: Back-Zip Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a zipper positioned at the centre back or back seam.

styles.name: Peplum Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a fitted or shaped bodice and a short flared panel around the waist.

styles.name: Wrap Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with overlapping front panels secured by a tie, belt, or fastening.

styles.name: Tie-Front Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with front panels or straps tied together at the front.

styles.name: Tie-Neck Blouse
styles.description: A blouse featuring a bow or tie detail around the neckline.

styles.name: Puff-Sleeve Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with sleeves gathered to create rounded volume at the shoulder or sleeve.

styles.name: Bishop-Sleeve Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with full sleeves gathered into a wrist cuff.

styles.name: Bell-Sleeve Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with sleeves that widen toward the cuff.

styles.name: Raglan-Sleeve Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with sleeves extending to the neckline and diagonal seams from underarm to neck.

styles.name: Off-Shoulder Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a neckline that sits below the shoulders.

styles.name: One-Shoulder Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with an asymmetrical neckline supported by one shoulder.

styles.name: Halter-Neck Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with straps or fabric that wrap or fasten around the neck.

styles.name: Bardot Blouse
styles.description: An off-shoulder blouse with a neckline that exposes both shoulders.

styles.name: Smocked Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with elasticated or stitched smocking used for texture and flexible fit.

styles.name: Ruffle-Front Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with ruffles arranged along the front opening or bodice.

styles.name: Pleated Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with pleats used for shaping, movement, or decoration.

styles.name: Draped Blouse
styles.description: A blouse using folds or draping to create soft volume or asymmetrical lines.

styles.name: Tunic Blouse
styles.description: A longer blouse extending below the hip, often worn over trousers or skirts.

styles.name: Sleeveless Blouse
styles.description: A blouse without sleeves, with shoulder and neckline shapes varying by design.

styles.name: Collared Blouse
styles.description: A blouse featuring a collar, which may be pointed, rounded, banded, or otherwise shaped.

styles.name: Round-Neck Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a rounded neckline.

styles.name: V-Neck Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a V-shaped neckline.

styles.name: Square-Neck Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a neckline shaped with relatively straight horizontal and vertical edges.

styles.name: Keyhole Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a small cut-out opening near the neckline or upper chest.

styles.name: Button-Back Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with buttons or a button placket at the back.

styles.name: Corset-Style Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with structured seams or shaping inspired by corset construction.

styles.name: Asymmetric Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with an intentionally uneven neckline, hem, closure, or panel arrangement.

styles.name: Peasant Blouse
styles.description: A relaxed blouse often featuring gathered fabric, a simple neckline, and loose sleeves.

styles.name: Kimono-Sleeve Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with wide sleeves cut as an extension of the body or with a deep underarm.

styles.name: High-Low Blouse
styles.description: A blouse with a hem that is shorter at the front and longer at the back.

styles.name: Kaftan Gown
styles.description: A long, gown-like kaftan with a loose or flowing silhouette.

styles.name: Women's Flowing Trousers
styles.description: Women's trousers designed with a generous, fluid leg, commonly using lightweight fabric.

styles.name: Women's Wide-Base Trousers
styles.description: Trousers with a particularly broad hem opening; this is a descriptive label that may overlap with wide-leg or palazzo styles.
